criteria.question: Does the story name the user role, the capability and the business value (As a / I want / So that)?
Are there acceptance criteria that are specific, independent and verifiable (ideally Given/When/Then), covering the happy path and key negative paths?
Are outcomes observable and unambiguous, with no vague terms (fast, user-friendly, etc.) left unquantified?
Are business rules, validations, data constraints and error handling stated?
Is it clear what is in and out of scope, and is the story small enough for one sprint?
Are dependencies (APIs, teams, feature flags, environments) and assumptions listed?
Where relevant, are performance, security, accessibility or compliance expectations stated?
For UI work, is there a mockup, design link or clear description of the screen behaviour?
